data.name: Muddasir
data.gender_notes: Muddasir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who maintains a garden or orchard, or one who guards, protects or preserves. The name Muddasir carries the meaning “Gardener, One who guards” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muddasir usually hope their child will grow to embody gardener, one who guards and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A protector of the spiritual garden of one's heart, ensuring its growth and purification.
data.etymology: Muddasir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gardener, One who guards.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muddasir total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مدسّر
in_arabic.meaning: المدثر، من دثر، من دثّر، الملتف بالثوب
in_arabic.long_meaning: المقصود بالمدسّر في القرآن الكريم هو سيدنا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ورد في سورة المدثر 'يا أيها المدثر'، أي الذي دثره الله بالدين وبالنبوة، و 'دثر' تعني في اللغة العربية كساء الثوب على شيء، فالمدسّر هو من يكسو شيئاً أو هو الملتف بالثوب

in_urdu.name: مدثر
in_urdu.meaning: مدثر، من دثر، من دثّر، الملتف بالثوب
in_urdu.long_meaning: مدثر نام کا مطلب ہے جو شخص ثوب یا لباس میں لپکا ہوا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة المدثر میں ذکر ہوا ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو مخاطب کرتے ہوئے کہا 'یا أيها المدثر'، یعنی وہ شخص جس کو اللہ تعالیٰ نے دین اور نبوت کے ذریعے خاص کیا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुदस्सिर
in_hindi.meaning: मुदस्सिर, मतलब है किसी के ऊपर वस्त्र या चादर ओढ़ाने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुदस्सिर नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति के ऊपर वस्त्र या चादर ओढ़ाता है, यह नाम कुरआन में सूरतुल मुदस्सिर में आया है, जहां अल्लाह तआला ने हज़रत मुहम्मद صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم को संबोधित करते हुए कहा 'يا أيها المدثر', यानी वह व्यक्ति जिसे अल्लाह ने धर्म और नबूवत के माध्यम से विशिष्ट किया है

in_pashto.name: مدسر
in_pashto.meaning: مدسر، د چادري يا کومبړۍ د اغوستلو په معنا
in_pashto.long_meaning: مدسر نوم معنی دادی هغه کسان چی کومبړۍ یا چادری اچولی، دا نوم د قرانکریم په سورت المدثرکې راغلی، چیرته چې الله تعالی حضرت محمد صلی الله علیه وسلم ته خطاب کوي او فرموي 'یا أيها المدثر'، یعنی هغه څوک چي الله ددين او نبوت په ذریعه ځانګړی کړی دی

in_english.name: Muddasir
in_english.long_meaning: The name Muddasir originates from Arabic roots and signifies someone wrapped in a cloak or covered. This name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Mudathir, where Allah addresses Prophet Muhammad as 'O you wrapped in a cloak.' The term 'muddasir' comes from the Arabic root 'd-th-r,' implying a sense of covering or enveloping. The name holds significant spiritual and historical importance as it refers to the Prophet Muhammad's role as a messenger of Allah, enveloped in divine guidance and protection.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muddasir, which comes from the Arabic word 'muddisirah' or 'mudassir', signifies a person who maintains a garden or orchard. This meaning is deeply rooted in Islamic culture, as gardening and agriculture have been essential components of Islamic societies throughout history. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) himself is reported to have said, "The best tree in the gardens of Paradise is the Shajarat al-Daqquq (meaning the fruit-laden tree)". Gardening and cultivating the land is seen as a noble and virtuous pursuit, reflecting the early Islamic credo "Iqamat al-'Alal" (striving in the cause of God). Thus, the cultural impact of the name Muddasir is one of hard work, perseverance, and a connection to nature.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muddasir carries the meaning of one who guards, protects, or preserves. In Islamic belief, this can be seen as a metaphor for guarding one's faith, shielding one's heart from the whispers of Satan, and safeguarding the community from harm. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The best guardian is he who guards the entry to something". The name Muddasir, then, can be seen as a reminder to be a protector and steward, maintaining the trusts that have been placed in us, and preserving the sacred bonds of family, community, and faith. Additionally, the name Muddasir can be seen as a reference to the station of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) in the afterlife, who is considered the Gatekeeper (Mudarris) of Paradise, granting access to those who have strived in the cause of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gardener, One who guards" symbolizes One who maintains a garden or orchard, or one who guards, protects or preserves.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muddasir serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gardener, one who guards.
